Where any deficit persists at the time of examination, the assignment moves to the infarction group.

source.source_quote: Uncomplicated lower urinary tract infection in a non-pregnant adult woman is treated empirically for three days without culture, and the lower tract entry carries the assignment. Recurrent infection, defined as three or more episodes in twelve months, prompts investigation for a structural cause and the underlying finding then carries the assignment where one is identified. In pregnancy the encounter takes the pregnancy-related genitourinary infection assignment from Chapter 18 whatever the tract involved, and asymptomatic bacteriuria is treated on the same footing as symptomatic infection because of the pyelonephritis and preterm labour risk. Male patients with lower tract symptoms are assessed for prostatic involvement. Fever above 38 degrees, loin pain or costovertebral angle tenderness moves the assignment to the upper tract entry irrespective of the presence of lower tract symptoms.

records.interpretation: Pregnancy, recurrent infection, male/prostatic context and upper-tract features narrow the uncomplicated lower-tract description.
